summary: Qualified PASS, read-only. The zero-context diff 1c17bd37..46234ef9 is exactly 9519 bytes, sha256 a82d114e560c3d09a1731ac2c746f603128b69f559479344aafc53350839c2bf. It is byte-identical (cmp) to approved-source.patch. All four blobs at 46234ef9 equal archive 68084d5b (74a17227, ed3e8015, ff740f43, 22c1fb21). The before/after sha256 values match source-binding.json and owner-approval.json. No other paths changed. The two hasLeadingProvenance helpers are identical in both files, and both call sites only swap the old line[2] startsWith check for the helper. Helper semantics: line 3 must be a quoted provenance line. The block runs from line 3 to the first line whose trimmed text is '---'. With no separator (-1) or a separator at index 2 or lower, the helper returns false. Every non-blank line in the block must start with '>'. The origin must match exactly through its closing backtick, so the forged '.forged' suffix and wrong origins are rejected. A note that appears only in the body (after the separator), unquoted prose, and a quote after an unquoted boundary line are all rejected. Existing guards are unchanged: in check.mjs, validateStub still rejects a 'Renumbered' target ('alvo é redirecionamento', C-01-02). In renumber.mjs, analyzeEntry's stub-for-other-id, to-exists and from-missing errors are unchanged. buildHeader still emits the '---' separator, so --write output satisfies the new helper. Real repo targets with provenance (ADR-0036/37/38/50/51/52) all have a leading quoted block ended by '---'. ADR-0051's extra blank-separated quote lines are accepted. There are no regressions. Tests: zero lines removed from either test file, so the original assertions are retained. The 9 vectors per file were traced against the old helper: 'valid multi-origin' and 'no separator' fail and the other 7 pass. That gives 14 PASS and 4 RED, matching red-result.json. green-result.json records focused 18/18 and full affected 122/122 with zero skips, cancellations or todos, plus exit 0 for the state-index check and the renumber dry-run. I did not execute anything; these figures come from the receipts. The README states the dry-run as 0 pending and 9 REVIEW; I did not independently rerun it. Scope: four approved paths only. No ADR, proof, index, pin or package change. This review grants no D1-L adoption, recovery, #211 merge, C6 unblock or S3 runtime. DEVAI 2.7.1 remains NOT QUALIFIED for U1/B1. Custody of main's 449-record chain, the held S2 169-record chain and the original 166-record chain is untouched. The results validate this source only and make no claim about any future S2 candidate. Release, adoption, CI and PR-only integration gates remain.
